diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
When the dispatcher Lambda is configured with VPC subnets, its VPC execution policy must be attached before Lambda creation so AWS can create the function's network interfaces. The function has no dependency on the VPC execution role attachment.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
When VPC configuration is enabled, the dispatcher Lambda needs the VPC execution policy attached before it is created/configured; otherwise Lambda may lack ENI permissions during setup. Add an explicit ordering dependency.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The dispatcher Lambda can be configured with VPC subnets, but its VPC execution-role policy attachment is not ordered before function creation. Lambda needs the VPC networking permissions when creating or updating a VPC-connected function; ensure the attachment is complete first. No clean attribute reference exists, so use depends_on.

When the webhook Lambda is configured with VPC subnets, its VPC execution policy must be attached before Lambda creation so AWS can create the function's network interfaces. The function has no dependency on the VPC execution role attachment.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
When VPC configuration is enabled, the webhook Lambda needs the VPC execution policy attached before it is created/configured; otherwise Lambda may lack ENI permissions during setup. Add an explicit ordering dependency.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The webhook Lambda can be configured with VPC subnets, but its VPC execution-role policy attachment is not ordered before function creation. Lambda needs the VPC networking permissions when creating or updating a VPC-connected function; ensure the attachment is complete first. No clean attribute reference exists, so use depends_on.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The EventBridge target can be registered before the Lambda invoke permission is in place, leaving the rule unable to invoke the function until permission is created. Ensure the permission exists before associating the target.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The EventBridge target can become active before the Lambda invoke permission exists. Ensure the target is ordered after the permission that grants EventBridge access to the dispatcher Lambda.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The EventBridge target can be installed before the Lambda permission that authorizes EventBridge to invoke the dispatcher, leaving the target unable to invoke the function until permission is established. Make the target wait for the permission with depends_on; the permission has no usable data attribute to reference.
